WHITNEY-CONFLUENCE.title: Confluence
WHITNEY-CONFLUENCE.description:
Draw {Cards:diff()} card.
Gain [gold]Ink[/gold] equal to the number of distinct elements played this turn (including this).
WHITNEY-WASH.title: Wash
WHITNEY-WASH.description:
Gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
If you played 2+ elements this turn, gain {Ink:diff()} [gold]Ink[/gold].
WHITNEY-SKETCH.title: Sketch
WHITNEY-SKETCH.description:
The next Seal you play costs [blue]0[/blue] [gold]Ink[/gold].
Gain {Ink:diff()} [gold]Ink[/gold].
WHITNEY-FLAME_SCRIPT.title: Flame Script
WHITNEY-FLAME_SCRIPT.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Fire[/gold] card, deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy.
WHITNEY-TIDE_SCRIPT.title: Tide Script
WHITNEY-TIDE_SCRIPT.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Water[/gold] card, gain {Block:diff()} [gold]Block[/gold].
WHITNEY-STONE_SCRIPT.title: Stone Script
WHITNEY-STONE_SCRIPT.description: Whenever you play an [gold]Earth[/gold] card, gain {Attune:diff()} [gold]Attunement[/gold].
WHITNEY-GALE_SCRIPT.title: Gale Script
WHITNEY-GALE_SCRIPT.description: The first {Times:diff()} [gold]Wind[/gold] card(s) you play each turn, draw 1 card.
WHITNEY-WORLD_SEAL.title: World Seal
WHITNEY-WORLD_SEAL.description:
Spend all your [gold]Ink[/gold].
Deal damage equal to ({Damage:diff()} + [gold]Attunement[/gold]) times [gold]Ink[/gold] spent to ALL enemies.
WHITNEY-PERFECT_SEAL.title: Perfect Seal
WHITNEY-NEGATIVE_SPACE.title: Negative Space
WHITNEY-INFERNO_SEAL.title: Inferno Seal
WHITNEY-INFERNO_SEAL.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage and apply {Vulnerable:diff()} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] and {Weak:diff()} [gold]Weak[/gold] to ALL enemies.
WHITNEY-MONUMENT.title: Monument
WHITNEY-LIVING_INK.title: Living Ink
WHITNEY-LIVING_INK.description: At the start of your turn, gain {Ink:diff()} [gold]Ink[/gold].
WHITNEY-ETERNAL_QUILL.title: Eternal Quill
WHITNEY-WET_PAINT.title: Wet Paint
WHITNEY-MASTERWORK.title: Masterwork
WHITNEY-MASTERWORK.description: Once per turn, when you play all 4 elements in a single turn, gain [blue]3[/blue] [gold]Ink[/gold], [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Attunement[/gold], and draw [blue]2[/blue] cards.
WHITNEY-ELEMENTAL_FORM.title: Elemental Form
WHITNEY-ELEMENTAL_FORM.description: Your cards count as every element for [gold]Blend[/gold] and [gold]Masterwork[/gold].
WHITNEY-TEMPEST.title: Tempest
WHITNEY-TEMPEST.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy X times.
WHITNEY-MONSOON.title: Monsoon
WHITNEY-MONSOON.description:
Gain [gold]Block[/gold] equal to {Block:diff()} times X.
Gain X [gold]Ink[/gold].
WHITNEY-PRISM_BURST.title: Prism Burst
WHITNEY-PRISM_BURST.description:
Gain X [gold]Attunement[/gold].
Deal damage equal to {Damage:diff()} + [gold]Attunement[/gold] to ALL enemies.
